newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Teledyne raises stainless prices.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Teledyne raises stainless prices.

text.p: Allegheny Teledyne Inc said in a letter to customers it will increase prices on stainless steel sheet, strip and plate products, effective with March 3 shipments.

The increase applies to sheet, strip, plate mill plate and continuous mill plate. Service center discounts for all 200, 300, and 400 series grades will be reduced by three percentage points, the company said.

The company said transaction tags to direct customers will also be increased for all 200, 300, and 400 series products. Direct customer transaction prices will reflect the reduction of three percentage points being applied to service center discounts.

The company said the increase is being implemented "to support continued quality improvements and also to allow (Allegheny Teledyne) to improve profitability for continued capital expenditures and growth."
